findings.evidence: The Reqwest client inherited environment or system proxies, allowing an authenticated literal-loopback HTTP request to be routed to an ambient proxy outside the validated connector destination.
findings.fix: Disable proxy inheritance for the strict client and prove a configured proxy cannot observe the loopback request or bearer.

findings.evidence: A 302 without Location did not prove bearer-safe redirect denial.
findings.fix: Redirect across authority to a live listener and assert the target is never contacted.

findings.evidence: The response-bound fixture did not cover cumulative unknown-length or chunked enforcement or exact-bound acceptance.
findings.fix: Exercise exact and over-limit chunked bodies.
